unmapped_findings: For the Fe-30Mn-1.2C-xAl set, the 4 wt.% Al and 6 wt.% Al alloys are only very weakly affected by the applied aging treatments in terms of their mechanical data, in contrast to Fe-30Mn-1.2C (weakening/embrittlement) and Fe-30Mn-1.2C-8Al (strengthening). [b0024]

With 4 wt.% Al (below 5 wt.%), a single austenite phase prevails at room temperature and the TWIP effect prevails as the deformation mechanism, classifying this as a single-phase austenitic TWIP (SIMPLEX) steel. [b0015, b0031]
The mechanical data for the intermediate 2–6 wt.% Al alloys fall between the respective values of the Al-free Fe-30Mn-1.2C alloy and the 8 wt.% Al alloy. [b0024]
